findings.highlight: put the bandage on
findings.evidenceJa: 包帯巻いてくれ
findings.governingReading: wrap the bandage more slowly
findings.explanation: The wrapping action causing Shirou pain becomes generic application.

findings.highlight: Sakura tapes up my middle finger
findings.evidenceJa: ぐるぐるぐる、と中指をテーピング
findings.governingReading: Sakura rapidly winds tape around and around his middle finger
findings.explanation: The repeated winding and comic sound-rhythm of Sakura’s forceful treatment disappear.

findings.highlight: Senpai’s body is swollen all over
findings.evidenceJa: 体のところどころが腫れあがってて
findings.governingReading: parts of Senpai’s body are badly swollen
findings.explanation: Scattered swollen areas become swelling over the entire body.

findings.highlight: He won’t even be able to take a bath tonight
findings.evidenceJa: これじゃお風呂にも入れません
findings.governingReading: in this condition he cannot even take a bath
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds a tonight-only time limit to Sakura’s objection.

findings.highlight: Saber glares at me in complaint
findings.evidenceJa: 不満げにこっちを見る
findings.governingReading: Saber looks at him with visible dissatisfaction
findings.explanation: mirror moon intensifies Saber’s dissatisfied look into a glare.

findings.highlight: There’s not much I can say
findings.evidenceJa: 申し訳なくて押し黙るしかない
findings.governingReading: he can only fall silent out of guilt
findings.explanation: The reason for Shirou’s silence—feeling guilty toward Saber—is omitted.

findings.highlight: You were staring into empty space
findings.evidenceJa: 見ているのは空ばかり
findings.governingReading: his gaze remained fixed on the sky
findings.explanation: A concrete image of Shirou looking toward the sky becomes generic vacant staring.

findings.highlight: I felt no spirit in your attacks
findings.evidenceJa: 気迫がまったく感じられなかった
findings.governingReading: Saber could sense no fighting spirit from him at all
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds attacks as the location of the missing spirit.

findings.highlight: makes my heart jump
findings.evidenceJa: また心臓がおかしくなりそ
findings.governingReading: his heart feels as though it will go strange again
findings.explanation: An ominous or disordered bodily reaction is normalized into a momentary jump.

findings.highlight: I just ate too much
findings.evidenceJa: 食いすぎで胃がもたれただけ
findings.governingReading: his stomach merely feels heavy from overeating
findings.explanation: The symptom supporting Shirou’s improvised excuse is omitted.

findings.highlight: I quickly move my face away
findings.evidenceJa: 咄嗟に桜から顔を離す
findings.governingReading: he reflexively jerks his face away from Sakura
findings.explanation: mirror moon retains speed but drops the instinctive, unplanned quality of his withdrawal.

findings.highlight: Sakura stands up to go to the kitchen
findings.evidenceJa: お茶の支度をしに台所に立つ
findings.governingReading: Sakura takes her place in the kitchen to prepare tea
findings.explanation: The English turns Sakura’s start of tea preparation into movement toward the kitchen.

findings.highlight: Her body is engraved in my mind
findings.evidenceJa: さっきの寝姿が脳裏に焼きついて
findings.governingReading: the sight of her sleeping earlier is burned into his mind
findings.explanation: A remembered sleeping pose is narrowed and sexualized into Sakura’s body.

findings.highlight: Please do not make it too hot
findings.evidenceJa: 温めでお願いします
findings.governingReading: please make it lukewarm
findings.explanation: A precise temperature request becomes an open-ended request to avoid excessive heat.

findings.highlight: how she looked earlier
findings.evidenceJa: 以前の寝みだれた姿
findings.governingReading: her earlier disheveled sleeping appearance
findings.explanation: A concrete, intimate memory is reduced to an unspecified earlier appearance.

findings.highlight: her soft lips
findings.evidenceJa: 柔らかそうだった唇
findings.governingReading: her lips, which had looked soft
findings.explanation: A visual impression is promoted into a stated tactile property.

findings.highlight: This is just lust
findings.evidenceJa: みっともない
findings.governingReading: this is shameful or disgraceful
findings.explanation: The mature branch inserts a categorical diagnosis of lust before the source’s self-reproach.

findings.highlight: I acted as her Senpai
findings.evidenceJa: 桜にだけは先輩として接してきた
findings.governingReading: he had always related to Sakura specifically as her senior
findings.explanation: A sustained relational boundary is phrased as though Shirou merely performed a role.

findings.highlight: it’s always been a different sort of affection
findings.evidenceJa: 好意の意味合いが違う
findings.governingReading: the meaning of that affection is different
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “always,” hardening the very history Shirou is about to question.

findings.highlight: pork meatloaf with egg and vegetables
findings.evidenceJa: 豚つくね焼き野菜添え
findings.governingReading: pork tsukune served with grilled vegetables
findings.explanation: mirror moon generalizes tsukune to meatloaf, invents egg, and loses that the vegetables are grilled accompaniments.

findings.highlight: sits down
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の定位置に戻っていった
findings.governingReading: returns to her usual place
findings.explanation: The familiar household fact that Sakura resumes her established seat disappears.

findings.highlight: Saber must enjoy tea, as she receives it with satisfaction
findings.evidenceJa: 食後のお茶が嬉しいのか、満足そうに
findings.governingReading: perhaps pleased by the after-dinner tea, Saber receives it looking satisfied
findings.explanation: A tentative reading of Saber’s expression becomes a causal certainty about enjoying tea generally.

findings.highlight: I shall wait until next time to strengthen you
findings.evidenceJa: シロウの強化は次の機会にするとしましょう
findings.governingReading: they will leave Shirou’s strengthening or development until next time
findings.explanation: The training-plan noun is rendered as Saber directly “strengthening” Shirou, inviting confusion with the named Magecraft technique.

findings.highlight: From now on, we will train you to survive
findings.evidenceJa: 生存方法を考慮するのはこれからです
findings.governingReading: from here they will consider a survival method that uses Shirou’s particular traits
findings.explanation: A future design and consideration stage becomes training already determined and underway.

findings.highlight: Whoa
findings.evidenceJa: 今の溜息
findings.governingReading: that sigh just now
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces the sigh Saber explicitly responds to with an exclamation.

findings.highlight: A-Are you serious?
findings.evidenceJa: そ、そうなのですか
findings.governingReading: s-so that is how it is
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comically formal, stunned acceptance becomes a challenge to Saber’s truthfulness.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s breathing painfully
findings.evidenceJa: 正座したまま、桜は苦しげに呼吸を乱していた
findings.governingReading: still seated formally in seiza, Sakura’s breathing is labored and disordered
findings.explanation: mirror moon produces a sentence fragment and omits the composed posture contrasting with Sakura’s respiratory distress.

findings.highlight: what’s wrong
findings.evidenceJa: なんでしょーか
findings.governingReading: what is it
findings.explanation: Sakura’s confused response to being shaken becomes a question implying that she sees a problem with Shirou.

findings.highlight: Sakura smiles in embarrassment
findings.evidenceJa: あはは、なんて照れ笑いをする桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura gives an embarrassed “ahaha” laugh and smile
findings.explanation: The audible laugh accompanying Sakura’s embarrassed smile disappears.

findings.highlight: Sakura bows
findings.evidenceJa: ぺこり、と一礼して
findings.governingReading: Sakura gives a small, quick bow
findings.explanation: The compact physical and sound-symbolic manner of Sakura’s bow disappears.
